name: scope-guard
description: Notices when Claude drifts outside your request. Clear drift waits for your answer in a question dialog; milder drift is flagged above the prompt with a pull-back key.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask stops clear drift with a question, flag only marks drift above the prompt, off checks nothing.

confirmModel.title: Confirm model
confirmModel.description: The model alias or id that confirms a drift the rules found before Scope Guard asks or flags.

manyFiles.title: Many files
manyFiles.description: How many distinct files Claude may change in one turn before Scope Guard counts it as a drift signal.
